Privacy Policy

Your Privacy, Handled with Care

Effective November 9, 2026

Sending Saints Cleaning Company (“Sending Saints,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) provides house cleaning, deep cleaning, and move-in/move-out cleaning services in and around Hickory, North Carolina. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, when we share it, and the choices you have.

Information We Collect

We collect information you give us when you visit this website, call, text, email, request a quote, book a service, or communicate with us. This may include:

  • Contact and booking details: your name, phone number, email address, service address, preferred appointment dates and times, and the service you select.
  • Home and service details: information needed to understand and quote the work, such as the type and size of the home, rooms or areas to be cleaned, service notes, and any access instructions you choose to provide.
  • Communications: messages, requests, feedback, and other information you send to us.
  • Booking and payment records: appointment history and limited transaction information connected with a booking.

Payments and Cards on File

Payments are processed by Square. When you pay or provide a card through a Square booking or payment page, your card details go to Square; Sending Saints does not receive or store your full card number or security code on this website.

As described during booking, Square may save a card on file for the appointment. That saved card may be used through Square for the booking deposit and for the confirmed balance connected with your service. Square handles payment information under its own privacy policy and security practices. We may view and use limited payment and transaction records needed to manage the booking, but not your full card details.

How We Use Information

We use personal information to:

  • Respond to calls, texts, emails, messages, and quote requests.
  • Schedule, confirm, manage, and provide cleaning services.
  • Review the details of a home and confirm its service price before the clean.
  • Process booking deposits and confirmed balances through Square.
  • Send appointment-related messages, service updates, and customer-support communications.
  • Maintain business, appointment, and transaction records.
  • Protect our business, customers, and systems from fraud, misuse, or unauthorized activity.
  • Understand and improve how we communicate with customers and provide our services.

What We Never Do

We never sell your personal information. We also do not share it for another company’s independent marketing.

When We Share Information

We share information only when reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including:

  • Square: Square provides the booking and payment services linked from this website. Information you enter on Square’s pages is handled by Square under its own terms and privacy policy.
  • Google: This website links to Google services, such as maps or reviews. If you choose to use those links, Google may collect and handle information under its own privacy policy.
  • Service support: We may use trusted providers that help us operate communications, scheduling, recordkeeping, or website services, limited to what they need to perform work for us.
  • Legal and safety reasons: We may disclose information when required by law or when reasonably necessary to protect rights, safety, property, or the integrity of our services.
  • With your direction: We may share information when you ask us to or otherwise direct us to do so.

Cookies and Website Technology

This is a static website and does not set cookies of its own or run its own advertising trackers. Third-party services that you choose to open from this site—including Square and Google—may use cookies or similar technologies under their own policies. Your browser settings may allow you to block or delete cookies, although doing so could affect how those third-party services work.

How Long We Keep Information

We keep personal information for as long as reasonably needed to provide services, maintain appointment and transaction records, meet legal or accounting obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When information is no longer needed for those purposes, we will delete it or take reasonable steps to remove identifying details, subject to any records we must retain.

Security

We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards appropriate to the information we handle. No website, payment system, message service, or method of storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Your Choices and Requests

You may contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information. You may also ask us to stop sending nonessential marketing messages. We may still need to send messages required to manage an appointment or transaction, and we may retain certain records when required for legal, accounting, security, or dispute-resolution reasons.

To protect your information, we may need to verify that a request relates to you before completing it. We will respond using the contact information you provide.

Children’s Privacy

Our services are intended for adults arranging cleaning services for a home. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us so we can review and delete it as appropriate.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy when our practices or legal obligations change. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

Contact Us
